limitations.text: No candidate depicts an attested early form of 爸. The images illustrate components only. All are modern vector redrawings, and their pixels were not inspected in this research pass because the web tool could not retrieve the SVGs.

The 巴 oracle-style file is labeled Shang oracle script style, but Commons flags the precise period as needing clarification. Its Sears-related reuse language should be followed despite the accompanying public-domain label.
